AI NEWS DAILY — Fri, 6 Nov 2026

TOP STORY: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber, a security model that leads with its containment score. ExploitGym rises to 48.5% (from 32.1%), and it avoided out-of-scope services in 99.93% of alignment tests without its deployment prompt, 100% with it. It has already validated thousands of exploits in Linux and Firefox.

5 KEY UPDATES
1. Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Small — 594B MoE, 17B active, image input, variable effort. Closed weights on Tinker now; Apache 2.0 next week after external red-teaming.
2. Four Chinese open-weight releases in one window: Baidu ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base (280B/14B, no post-training), Moonshot Kimi K3.1 Pro (1M context), Ant Ling-3.2-flash (560B/25B multimodal) and Tencent Hy4 (vision + computer use).
3. AI stocks cracked: S&P 500 -4.4%, Dow -1,833 points, Nasdaq -5.5% and 11.9% below its record, led by data-center names.
4. Google agreed to backstop Anthropic's $19bn Kentucky data-center lease; Democrats pledged AI regulation after their midterm wins.
5. Science models language learning from children's first 1,000 days of speech; Nature Machine Intelligence links unstable model behaviour to fractal basin geometry.

CONCEPT OF THE DAY: Scope Discipline — why the most important number in a cyber model is the one measuring what it refuses to do.

Full briefing: https://dilip457.github.io/ai-news-daily/
